main_body: multi-story brick building with mansard roof
top_band: blue-grey mansard roof and upper deck (rows 16-43) with orange cornice at rows 44-45
evidence: The building shows a 30-row sloped roof and upper deck surface above a 96-row vertical facade, separated by a bright cornice (row 44) and dark eave shadow (rows 46-47), with recessed windows and doorway.

style.evidence: While the brickwork and roof slates have decent block detailing, the piece relies on heavy near-black outlines around the roof, dormers, chimney, and walls, and uses large geometric blocks rather than the fine per-stone/per-tile grain and tinted material outlines of the Beodeul references.
